decision: Ali selected bounded synthetic V1 convention on 22 October 2026; this does not approve market comparability, historical price validity or evaluation answers.
quote_arithmetic_basis: Fictional tax-exclusive list price and standard cost per stored product unit; no freight or tax adjustment is included in catalogue margin arithmetic.
temporal_interpretation: The current reader uses one static versioned V1 catalogue across simulated historical and evaluation cutoffs. This is a synthetic scenario convention, not evidence of historical market prices or a per-SKU effective interval.
public_anchor_role: Taxonomy and broad synthetic generator-band design only; no individual fictional SKU has a verified like-for-like external price or procurement cost.

date_fields.catalogue_calibration_date_role: research/configuration date, not a SKU observation or validity date
date_fields.fx_reference_date_role: normalization input for sampled USD anchors, not a price-effective date
date_fields.portfolio_as_of_at_role: draft portfolio snapshot timestamp, not a universal price-effective date

scope_boundary: The approved v2 evaluation costing convention is case-scoped; this V1 proposal does not modify its contract, source definitions or hashes.
